import { setup } from "../../../src/index.js"

/** No agent or certified child activates the new settlement gate. */
const s = setup({})
/** Existing wide annotations remain accepted in a plain setup. */
declare const wide: { readonly initial: string; readonly states: Readonly<Record<string, object>> }
/** Existing optional states remain accepted in a plain setup. */
declare const optional: Partial<{ initial: "x"; states: { x: { after: { 1: "done" } }; done: { type: "final" } } }>
/** Plain setups preserve their prior treatment of erased configurations. */
declare const erased: any
/** The annotated configuration remains accepted. */
export const annotated = s.createMachine(wide)
/** The optional configuration remains accepted. */
export const partial = s.createMachine(optional)
/** The erased configuration remains accepted. */
export const anyConfig = s.createMachine(erased)
